name: 43803-sharegpt-nemotronh8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8 (equal to max-num-seqs), bounded at 480 requests with a 900 s safety cap, no warmup and no cooldown.
workload: ShareGPT V3 unfiltered cleaned split, 480 single-turn prompts (108427 prompt tokens; mean 225.9, p50 85, p90 656, max 1007), every request forced to exactly 300 output tokens via max_tokens plus ignore_eos, greedy, `request_format: plain`. Materialised as `configs/data/sharegpt-480-out300-nemotronh.jsonl` by `configs/data/make-dataset.py`.
purpose: A general-purpose 8B chat assistant handling conversational prompts with eight concurrent users on a single GPU.
launch:
model: nvidia/Nemotron-H-8B-Base-8K
tensor-parallel-size: 1
# What `dtype: auto` resolves to from this checkpoint, written out so a default cannot drift it.
dtype: bfloat16
# Below the model's own 8192 context window, above the workload's worst case of 1024 + 300.
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-seqs: 8
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.85
enable-prefix-caching: false
